ns2:course.label: Government Internship
ns2:course.description: Selected Government Internship participants together with faculty sponsor develop a program of study and research related to internship assignment. Consult departmental undergraduate advisor. No graduate credit. Approved for both letter and S/U grading. May be repeated to a maximum of 12 hours. Prerequisite: Junior standing; 3.0 grade average for most internships; PS 101 and one 300-level political science course appropriate to internship program; acceptance by faculty sponsor.
